title: Two-dimensional Janus α-Au2XY (X, Y = S/Se/Te) semiconductors with favourable band gaps and high carrier mobilities predicted by first-principles investigations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18114-18122
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01319D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen T. Hiep, Quach K. Quang, Mai T. V. Nhan, Khanh V. Hoang, Cuong Q. Nguyen, Bui D. Hoi, Nguyen N. Hieu
In this work, two-dimensional Janus α-Au2XY (X, Y = S/Se/Te) monolayers are designed and their structural stabilities and fundamental properties are investigated using first-principle calculations.
